'''2026 Tatooine Regionals Randy Scott LS mwyhlv''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Randy Scott]] at [[2026 Regional Championships]] (Tatooine).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Randy Scott]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Regional Championships]]
* '''Stage:''' Tatooine
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)|VB6-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned-pre.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26Tatooine Scott LS MWYHLv.txt |Download]]
